SELECT i.immune_id, i.record_id, i.pet_id, i.client_id, i.doctor_id, i.drug_id, i.drug_name, i.dose_cnt, i.vaccinate_time, i.next_time, i.note, i.create_time, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name FROM immune_record i LEFT JOIN pet p ON i.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON i.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON i.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE i.is_del = 0 AND i.next_time IS NOT NULL
AND p.pet_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{petName}, '%')
AND i.next_time BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
ORDER BY i.next_time ASC

SELECT i.immune_id, i.record_id, i.pet_id, i.client_id, i.doctor_id, i.drug_id, i.drug_name, i.dose_cnt, i.vaccinate_time, i.next_time, i.note, i.create_time, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name FROM immune_record i LEFT JOIN pet p ON i.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON i.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON i.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE i.is_del = 0 AND i.pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY i.vaccinate_time DESC
